final: SELECT AVG(avg_press) AS avg_of_avg_pressratio, AVG(avg_rate) AS avg_of_avg_gb_per_min FROM (SELECT s.zoneref, st.typesite, AVG(s.pressratio) AS avg_press, AVG(s.gbsize / s.spanmin) AS avg_rate FROM scans s JOIN sites st ON st.zoneregistry = s.zoneref WHERE s.chronotag > '2024-06-06 11:53:59.684274' AND s.chronotag < '2024-11-03 19:51:13.516797' GROUP BY s.zoneref, st.typesite)
